iso_20022_rules.RelatedPresentWhenCopyDupl: If CopyDuplicate is present, Related MUST be present.
iso_20022_rules.InstructedAgentRule: If GrpHdr/InstdAgt is present, then CdtTrfTxInf/InstdAgt is not allowed.
iso_20022_rules.InstructingAgentRule: If GrpHdr/InstgAgt is present, then CdtTrfTxInf/InstgAgt is not allowed.
iso_20022_rules.TotalInterbankSettlementAmountRule: If GrpHdr/TtlIntrBkSttlmAmt is present, all CdtTrfTxInf/IntrBkSttlmAmt must use the same currency.
iso_20022_rules.TotalInterbankSettlementAmountAndSumRule: If GrpHdr/TtlIntrBkSttlmAmt is present, it must equal the sum of all CdtTrfTxInf/IntrBkSttlmAmt.
iso_20022_rules.GroupHeaderInterbankSettlementDateRule: If GrpHdr/IntrBkSttlmDt is present, CdtTrfTxInf/IntrBkSttlmDt is not allowed.
iso_20022_rules.TransactionInterbankSettlementDateRule: If GrpHdr/IntrBkSttlmDt is not present, CdtTrfTxInf/IntrBkSttlmDt MUST be present.
iso_20022_rules.PaymentTypeInformationRule: If GrpHdr/PmtTpInf is present, CdtTrfTxInf/PmtTpInf is not allowed.
iso_20022_rules.NumberOfTransactionsAndCreditTransfersRu: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs must equal the number of CdtTrfTxInf occurrences.
iso_20022_rules.UndrlygCstmrCdtTrfRule: In COV usage, CdtTrfTxInf/UndrlygCstmrCdtTrf MUST be present and carry the underlying pacs.008 customer credit transfer details.
iso_20022_rules.CoverSettlementMethodRule: GrpHdr/SttlmInf/SttlmMtd MUST be INDA or INGA for CBPR+ pacs.009 COV messages (cover settled on accounts). COVE is NOT permitted for COV — it belongs to pacs.009 ADV. Verified against SWIFT MyStandards.
iso_20022_rules.DuplicateIdentifierValue: [DUPLICATE_ID_VALUE] Identifiers required to be unique within a message (e.g. InstrId, TxId, EndToEndId, UETR) must not repeat across transactions or collide with GrpHdr/MsgId.
iso_20022_rules.BicNotInDirectory: [BIC_NOT_FOUND] Each BICFI should resolve to a registered institution in the official BIC directory.
iso_20022_rules.MissingLeiAdvisory: [MISSING_LEI_ADVISORY] Under SR2026 a Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) is highly recommended for all financial institutions.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr/BizMsgIdr must equal GrpHdr/MsgId
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Harvest MsgId from GrpHdr and set BizMsgIdr to same value or vice versa.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr/Fr/BICFI must equal CdtTrfTxInf/InstgAgt/BICFI (unless CpyDplct=COPY/CODU)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Harvest InstgAgt BICFI and set AppHdr/Fr to match.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr/To/BICFI must equal CdtTrfTxInf/InstdAgt/BICFI
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Harvest InstdAgt BICFI and set AppHdr/To to match.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs must equal count of CdtTrfTxInf blocks
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Count CdtTrfTxInf elements and update NbOfTxs.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: GrpHdr/CtrlSum must equal sum of all IntrBkSttlmAmt
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Sum IntrBkSttlmAmt values and update CtrlSum.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr/Prty must equal PmtTpInf/InstrPrty when both present
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Align both to same value; default NORM.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: GrpHdr/InstgAgt and CdtTrfTxInf/InstgAgt are mutually exclusive (R5)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove from one level; keep at the other.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: GrpHdr/InstdAgt and CdtTrfTxInf/InstdAgt are mutually exclusive (R4)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove from one level; keep at the other.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: GrpHdr/PmtTpInf and CdtTrfTxInf/PmtTpInf are mutually exclusive (R10)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove from one level; keep at the other.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: IntrBkSttlmDt must be at either GrpHdr or CdtTrfTxInf, not both (R8/R9)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Keep at one level only.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: XchgRate required iff InstdAmt.Ccy != IntrBkSttlmAmt.Ccy
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Add XchgRate when currencies differ; remove when same.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: IntrmyAgt2 requires IntrmyAgt1; IntrmyAgt3 requires IntrmyAgt2
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Insert missing predecessor agent(s).

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: If FinInstnId/BICFI present, then Nm and PstlAdr MUST NOT be present in same block
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove Nm and PstlAdr when BICFI is present.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: If Nm present in FinInstnId, PstlAdr must also be present and vice versa
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Add the missing counterpart; or use BICFI.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: BrnchId is removed from all agent elements under CBPR+ SR2025
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove all BrnchId elements from agent blocks.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: GrpHdr/SttlmInf/SttlmMtd MUST be INDA or INGA in CBPR+ pacs.009 COV (COVE not permitted)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Set SttlmMtd to INGA (or INDA). COVE is only for pacs.009 ADV; remove reimbursement agents if present.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: UndrlygCstmrCdtTrf MUST be present in pacs.009 COV (R12)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Insert UndrlygCstmrCdtTrf block populated from the originating pacs.008.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: CdtTrfTxInf/PmtId/UETR must equal UndrlygCstmrCdtTrf/PmtId/UETR (CBPR_COV_UETR_PROPAGATION)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Set both UETRs to the same UUID v4 value from the originating pacs.008.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: CdtTrfTxInf/PmtId/EndToEndId should match UndrlygCstmrCdtTrf/PmtId/EndToEndId
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Harvest EndToEndId from the originating pacs.008 and propagate to both locations.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr must be 'pacs.009.001.08' and AppHdr/BizSvc must be 'swift.cbprplus.cov.03'
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Set MsgDefIdr to 'pacs.009.001.08' and BizSvc to 'swift.cbprplus.cov.03'.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: UndrlygCstmrCdtTrf/DbtrAgt must differ from UndrlygCstmrCdtTrf/CdtrAgt (loopback check)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Verify BICs differ; identical BICs indicate a loopback payment.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: When GrpHdr/SttlmInf/SttlmMtd is COVE, at least one of CdtTrfTxInf/InstgRmbrsmntAgt or CdtTrfTxInf/InstdRmbrsmntAgt must be present.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Add InstgRmbrsmntAgt and/or InstdRmbrsmntAgt with a valid BICFI, or change SttlmMtd to INDA/INGA/CLRG.

schema_mapping_notes.root_element: pacs.009.001.08 COV root is /Document/FICdtTrf (FinancialInstitutionCreditTransfer, cover variant); the AppHdr (BAH) precedes the Document.
schema_mapping_notes.msg_def_idr: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr must be 'pacs.009.001.08' matching urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:pacs.009.001.08. Do NOT use a pacs.008 identifier here.
schema_mapping_notes.biz_svc: AppHdr/BizSvc for CBPR+ pacs.009 COV is 'swift.cbprplus.cov.03' (NOT 'swift.cbprplus.03', which is for the CORE / pacs.008 services).
schema_mapping_notes.structure: GrpHdr [1..1] + CdtTrfTxInf [1..n], where each CdtTrfTxInf MUST contain UndrlygCstmrCdtTrf carrying the underlying customer credit transfer being covered (the cover for a pacs.008). The FI-level transfer moves the cover funds between correspondents.
schema_mapping_notes.amount_location: FI-level IntrBkSttlmAmt sits under CdtTrfTxInf; the underlying customer amounts (IntrBkSttlmAmt / InstdAmt) sit under UndrlygCstmrCdtTrf.
schema_mapping_notes.cover_propagation: PmtId/UETR and EndToEndId at the cover level must match the underlying customer transfer (UETR propagation rule CBPR_COV_UETR_PROPAGATION).
schema_mapping_notes.reimbursement_agents: Cover settlement uses reimbursement agents: InstgRmbrsmntAgt and/or InstdRmbrsmntAgt are required when SttlmMtd is COVE; ThrdRmbrsmntAgt is optional.
schema_mapping_notes.datetime_format: ISODateTime fields use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM; no 'Z' suffix, no milliseconds.
schema_mapping_notes.nb_of_txs_scope: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs must equal the number of CdtTrfTxInf occurrences.
